replace.description: Replace an existing definition with this id.

commandPoints.description: Command Points one unit occupies, from queue to death.

maxCount.description: Per-player limit, counted from queue to death.

slotLimit.description: The most of this unit one Unit Slot holds; more take another slot. Unset is no limit.

roles.description: Hints for the Battle AI: which roles it picks this unit for first. A scout roams to look and falls back from the enemy; a skirmisher patrols between points and hunts what it's good against.
